The product

One conversation, two ways.

The moment no interpreter is there, everyday communication becomes a wall. Existing tools need the internet, a camera, wait time, or someone else to speak for you. Turjuman removes all of it.

Turjuman Glove

An AI-powered smart glove that translates Arabic Sign Language into spoken Arabic in real time. Standalone with its own speaker and battery — no phone required.

Turjuman Prototype

The prototype that proved the concept — exposed flex sensors across every finger and the full wiring that made the AI training possible.

How it works

From gesture to speech in under 200 ms.

01

Sign a phrase

The wearer signs naturally in Arabic Sign Language.

02

Glove captures motion

Flex sensors and a 6-axis tracker read every bend and rotation.

03

On-device AI classifies

A built-in model recognises the sign with 99% accuracy — entirely offline.

04

Arabic speech output

The phrase plays through the built-in speaker as clear spoken Arabic.

Engineering

Our own hardware, our own model.

Turjuman is built from the ground up in Bahrain. Six core components turn a hand gesture into a spoken sentence.

Flex sensors
Read finger bending across all five fingers.
Motion tracker
6-axis IMU catching hand rotation and movement.
Micro computer
ESP32-class board running everything on-device.
Machine learning
Custom model trained on multiple signers for 99% accuracy.
Lithium battery
Built-in power with battery safety designed in.
Speaker
Plays the translation aloud — no phone needed.
5

Finger bending

One flex reading per finger, capturing the exact shape of every sign.

6

Axes of motion

Rotation on X, Y and Z plus acceleration — position and gesture both captured.

Impact

Five goals. One product.
